input.title: Charred Corn and Lime Salad | TextSous Fixtures
input.rawText: Charred Corn and Lime Salad Serves 4 as a side dish. Ingredients 4 ears corn, shucked 1 tablespoon olive oil 1 lime, juiced 1/4 cup chopped cilantro 1/2 teaspoon kosher salt Instructions Brush the corn with the olive oil. Char on a hot grill, turning, until blackened in spots, about 8 minutes. Cut the kernels from the cobs into a bowl. Toss with the lime juice, cilantro, and salt. Serve warm.
